text:
maria: seeing a sudden spike in 502/504s from ap-southeast-2 customers since ~2026-03-16T10:22Z. multiple reports of timeouts and auth retries.
sanjay: confirmed - hosted-inference-prod az2 tail latency and gateway errors up. graphs show packet drops on egress.
alice-support: customer C-24567 escalated, user sees POST /v1/generate timeout consistently at ~8s. asking for repro steps.
devon: pulled proxy logs and traces, many upstream TCP retransmits/RSTs to egress-gw-ap2. sample trace ids: t-9a8b, t-9a8c.
ingrid-ontcall: quick network checks from egress host: `ping -c 50 203.0.113.12` -> 3-7% packet loss, 80-200ms jitter intermittently.
netops: carrier ops called in - they observed an AS-path change and micro-blackholing for ~3m on a transit peer. provider ticket TransitOps-4321 opened.
maria: can we give a short repro to customers and a suggested mitigant (retry/failover)? want something simple to paste.
alice-support: repro we used: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate --data @prompt.json --max-time 10` -> 502 after ~8s, sometimes 504. note: auth token validated then upstream timed out.
devon: tcpdump snippet from gateway (abbreviated): ```23:11:12.345678 IP 10.0.3.45.443 > 10.1.4.22.54321: Flags [S.], seq 1, ack 1, win 64240``` repeated with retransmits and duplicate acks.
maria: mitigation plan: enable routing-policy fallback to eu2 for affected prefixes and increase gateway retry window to 15s. rolling now :rocket:
transit-bot: Provider update: asymmetric path after upstream peer withdrew prefixes; working on route flap dampening and peer fixes; estimated stabilization 40m. ticket TransitOps-4321.
sanjay: starting canary reroute to eu2, will watch error rate. if stable, promote to full reroute. setting alerts to 10% error threshold.
alice-support: notified impacted customers on email + status page. note in message: "We are routing around transit instability; please retry requests or use eu2 region as temporary workaround." billing unaffected.
maria: leaving thread open until provider confirms route stability and our 5xx rate returns to baseline. ping here with any regression or carrier ETA changes :eyes:
